actual_findings.finding: RPA and AI integration experience is required in wording; no numeric duration is stated. Lack of a numeric hit cannot be zero years.
Six-plus years of creative/design experience with a preferred business environment; mentoring junior designers concerns other employees. Generative AI use is an explicit content requirement.

Bachelor-level and master-level duration clauses differ. Literal12 and6-to10 values are captured, but the master branch is incorrectly marked unconditional. Accept numeric text inventory; reject collapsing to a job-wide unconditional minimum.

Six-plus years of marketing experience and a separate year of supervision experience coexist. The role starts as an individual contributor; past supervision does not establish present supervisory duties.

Three-plus years of applicable AI-workflow experience is numeric and substantively related, but rule object is unresolved. Narrow object filters select what the dictionary recognizes, not all genuine related experience.
Preferred experience mentoring junior analysts is past experience, not a current duty. The aggregate v1 responsibility union is therefore superseded by v2's explicit-duty and evidence-kind gate.

accepted_observables.T1: Processing and mapping coverage in this fixed sample; not semantic success or total-corpus coverage
accepted_observables.T2: Rule-defined experience wording and literal duration inventory, with unresolved/conditional states and denominators. Four object classes remain algorithmic text categories, not fully validated economic experience requirements
accepted_observables.T3: Specified technology lexicon matches, overlaps and explicitly defined proximity/use-language indicators. Not actual deployment/developer occupation labels
accepted_observables.T4: Created-year metadata composition and stated availability limits. Raw text sometimes contains dates; those are not a universal verified version/date field in this release
accepted_observables.T5: Finite-sample document-level wording cooccurrence, BOTH general and related retained; eligibility and responsibility indicators have explicit broad/narrow definitions. Not entrant share or seniorization
accepted_observables.T6: Sensitivity of those operational statistics and explicit claim-availability status; narrow selection is not an accuracy guarantee

not_accepted_as_substantive_conclusions: AI versus computerization historical effect comparison
finite_stop_decision: Publish six corrected descriptive tables and a findings/limitations page. Close this processing-and-measurement-evaluation release. Do not launch another parser, model, sampling or API cycle just to remove the remaining unknowns.
aggregation_correction: Only v2 qualifies for this acceptance: prior mentoring experience excluded from added current-duty union; v1 and its arithmetic QA preserved as superseded.
result_integrity: Receipt/index/quote checks verify engineering consistency only. This decision does not convert them into a semantic accuracy rate.
